Preventive Philosophy

Preventing Equipment Failure Before Exams Begin

Most schools only call a technician when a smart board stops responding during a lecture or an exam printer jams thirty minutes before morning assembly.

Emergency break-fix repairs are expensive, cause acute stress for school leadership, and disrupt the academic timetable. EDUONE's structured AMC model replaces chaotic reactive repairs with disciplined, routine preventive maintenance conducted during school holidays and weekends.

Scheduled Holiday ServicingDeep cleaning, software image restoration, and lab servicing done during summer, autumn and winter breaks.
Single Contract CoverageOne unified AMC agreement covering computers, smart boards, CCTV and network switches under one accountable team.

Maintenance Contracts

Comprehensive & Non-Comprehensive AMC Packages

Choose between full parts-inclusive agreements or labour-only preventive servicing plans structured around your school's equipment asset register.

Monthly or Bi-Monthly Scheduled Visits

Computer Lab & Desktop AMCs

Routine physical cleaning, internal fan dust extraction, thermal repasting, OS optimization, driver updates and anti-virus status verification across student lab PCs and admin desks.

Covered Scope:
  • ✓Hardware diagnostics identifying failing RAM modules or hard disks early
  • ✓Software image cloning to restore student lab PCs after semester exams
  • ✓Peripherals check (keyboards, optical mice, monitors and power cords)
  • ✓Standby backup desktop allocation during emergency repairs

Pre-Term & Quarterly Servicing

Interactive Smart Board & Projector Care

Preventive optical care and calibration for classroom interactive flat panels and auditorium projectors. Ensuring maximum brightness, color accuracy and glitch-free touch response.

Covered Scope:

  • ✓Projector air filter cleaning and lamp/laser life monitoring

Monthly Health Diagnostics

CCTV & Video Surveillance Maintenance

Critical health verification of the campus safety grid. Camera lens cleaning, focus adjustment, power supply checks, and thorough NVR hard drive integrity monitoring.

Covered Scope:
  • ✓Camera housing cleaning and spider-web removal on outdoor cameras
  • ✓Verification that 30/90 days retention compliance is strictly preserved
  • ✓Time synchronization across all cameras for legal evidentiary validity
  • ✓BNC/RJ45 connector crimping and weatherproof junction box inspection
